scripts.preinstall:
node -e "const want='23';const got=process.versions.node;if(got.split('.')[0]!==want){console.error('
  Desk requires Node '+want+'.x (pinned by .nvmrc + engines). Found: '+got+'.
  Install via nvm/fnm/mise/asdf, then re-run npm install. The .nvmrc pin will pick up automatically.
');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build:server: npm -w @agent-desk/shared run build && npm -w @agent-desk/db run build && npm -w @agent-desk/storage run build && npm -w @agent-desk/runtime run build && npm -w @agent-desk/scheduler run build && npm -w @agent-desk/api run build && npm -w @agent-desk/sandbox-cli run build
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:server && npm -w @agent-desk/ui run build && npm -w @agent-desk/app-scaffold run build && npm -w @agent-desk/app run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:server && npm -w @agent-desk/ui run build && npm -ws --if-present run typecheck
